preload.description:
`import { preload } from 'react-dom';`

Download a resource ahead of time without executing it.
`crossOrigin` is required when `as: 'fetch'`.

提前下载资源但不执行它。`as: 'fetch'` 时必须提供 `crossOrigin`。

preinit.description:
`import { preinit } from 'react-dom';`

Download AND execute a script eagerly. Use `preload` if you only want to download it.

提前下载并执行脚本。若只需下载不执行，请使用 `preload`。

preinit Stylesheet.description:
`import { preinit } from 'react-dom';`

`precedence` is required for stylesheets, it controls the insertion order in the document.

样式表必须提供 `precedence`，它决定样式在文档中的插入顺序。

preloadModule.description:
`import { preloadModule } from 'react-dom';`

Download an ESM module ahead of time without evaluating it.

提前下载 ESM 模块但不执行它。

preinitModule.description:
`import { preinitModule } from 'react-dom';`

Download AND evaluate an ESM module eagerly. Use `preloadModule` if you only want to download it.

提前下载并执行 ESM 模块。若只需下载不执行，请使用 `preloadModule`。

preconnect.description:
`import { preconnect } from 'react-dom';`

Eagerly open a connection to a server you expect to load resources from. Prefer `prefetchDNS` when connecting to many domains speculatively.

提前与目标服务器建立连接。若需要推测性地连接大量域名，请优先使用 `prefetchDNS`。

prefetchDNS.description:
`import { prefetchDNS } from 'react-dom';`

Eagerly look up the IP of a server you expect to load resources from. Cheaper than `preconnect`.

提前解析目标服务器的 IP，开销比 `preconnect` 更低。
